name: Clear Pumpkin — No Pumpkin Blur
summary: Removes the orange pumpkin blur overlay so you can see clearly while wearing a pumpkin.
body:
Wearing a pumpkin for the Enderman trick? The vanilla orange blur makes it hard to see. This pack **removes the blur entirely**.

- 🎃 **No more orange overlay** — full clear vision
- ✅ **Works on every launcher** — just drop in `resourcepacks` and enable

---

### 🚀 Want everything in one pack?
This feature is part of **[PvP Essentials](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/texture-packs/fliflight-pvp-essentials)** — the all-in-one pack with crosshair, visible ores, short sword, low fire and clear pumpkin.
> 💡 **CurseForge is the source of truth** for this pack — the most up-to-date, bug-free versions are always there first: [CurseForge page](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/texture-packs/fliflight-clear-pumpkin)

version.changelog: Initial release: removes the pumpkin blur overlay entirely.
